profile: A disposable HOME, an environment credential backend, fictional identity (Mira Example) and a closed fictional ACME world; no network access beyond the isolated app's own origin.

fixture.summary: The public ACME documentation fixture plus a deterministic agent runner. A chat turn calls the unmodified stdio MCP server's heinzel_wake tool, which only proposes the action; no model is called and usage is zero.

stories.graph: /contracts: Discover, Fit View, select the contract node, zoom with the graph's own wheel zoom.
stories.terminal: /contracts/weekly-report: Open a terminal, run hz heinzel graph, New terminal tab, run hz heinzel drafts --name weekly-report --latest, Full screen, Leave full screen.
stories.chat: /contracts/weekly-report?chat-context=contract:weekly-report: send a message in the real composer; the real proposal card appears.

acceptance.chat: Browser journey observed: one pending action; the saved-run count unchanged while pending; plus one run after Confirm; no run after Decline.

privacy.redaction: Authentication presentation and the disposable profile path are replaced in the page before every save (the path becomes /demo-profile); page text is scanned for credentials, paths, hosts and non-example email addresses.
privacy.review: Two independent agent reviews of the exact bytes; the second found no privacy issue in any of the nine images.
privacy.bundle_sha256_of: the private review manifest listing every image and its page-text transcript
